_comment: Hand-maintained. 'available' here means the free Tier 1 backward explorer has real content for this ticker -- a model has actually been built and backward-tested (METHODOLOGY.md Requirement 2), even if the accuracy isn't strong yet. Transparency is the point of the free tier: an honest 62.6%-accuracy model is still worth showing. This is a SEPARATE, lower bar than 'good enough to sell forward predictions for' -- that bar only applies to the paid mobile app (not built yet) and is not what this file controls. Each entry's explainability data lives at data/explainability/<TICKER>.json, exported from the private repo by hand (no backend/cross-repo credential -- see MISSION.md).

covered.teaser: v2 model (price action + real Google Trends sentiment), 62.8% directional accuracy in backward tests -- explore exactly how it reasons, including where it's still wrong.
